title: Rav Shmuel of Zrokinya

paragraphs: Mentioned in Chullin 111a: Rav Ashi challenged it—or, some say, Rav Shmuel of Zrokinya.[^1]

notes.text: קיא. gives Chullin 111a under the period convention, without independent named-edition verification. Initial mem in מזרוקיניא is read locatively as of-Zrokinya rather than the older single-word Mizrokinya; no new geographic identity is established. Some-say preserves alternative attribution to Ashi or Shmuel. All three Rav occurrences are full.
